title: Stratos
identity: Ruud Roelofsen’s Stratos (2013) is for tenor saxophone in B-flat and piano, about eight minutes; Donemus catalog 13298. The score cover identifies it as a transposed score, partly improvised, and dedicated to ensemble Parallel Asteroid.

evidence.claim: The Donemus preview cover specifies a transposed score for tenor saxophone in B-flat and piano, says the piece is partly improvised, identifies ensemble Parallel Asteroid, and gives duration about eight minutes.
Donemus catalog page is the listed publisher record; direct page retrieval failed, but its public score preview was retrieved via the publisher form.

score_observations: The inspected preview begins with an approximately 24-second crescendo gesture, then an “overblow” passage. Later boxed gestures specify mouthpiece chewing, air noise, and key clicks. Piano notation uses unconventional graphic symbols and clusters; the preview does not explicitly label these as string scraping. The score cover says partly improvised. The four-page preview does not establish that it contains the whole work.
review_focus: Inference from inspected score: clarify the realization of the piano’s graphic symbols and coordinate composed passages, improvisation, and gesture-based timing with the tenor line.
collection_flag: Original contemporary duo for tenor saxophone and piano, partly improvised; cover labels the score transposed.

score_links.description: Donemus public preview retrieved via POST form; four-page PDF visually inspected.

gaps: The four-page preview may not include every page; exact form and written range remain unknown.
The preview does not establish that the piano symbols instruct scraping strings, or that time indications are suggestions.
No recording was auditioned and college/professional or pedagogical placement was not verified.
